motion.framer_motion: Staggered fade-up for restaurant cards, floating droplet particle micro-animations, googly eyes tracking cursor on logo hover
motion.cursor_effects: Gentle magnetic pull on primary CTA buttons

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text, 3:1 for large)
accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system settings and disable parallax/marquee on reduced motion
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, search inputs, cuisine filter tabs, restaurant cards, and download buttons must have role-based kebab-case testids

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the bright, playful, rounded look with crisp white/warm-cream background, vibrant Foodysh orange (#FF5C1A), fresh green (#17A34A), and sunny yellow (#FFC531).
Ensure the hero video autoplays muted in a loop with fallback poster and dark gradient overlay so all text remains crisp and 100% accessible.
Render the authentic Foodysh SVG logo featuring googly eyes in 'oo', 3 colorful crown droplets, and the tagline 'Good Food • Faster • Happier'.
Include high-fidelity Nashik restaurant data (Sadhana Chulivarchi Misal, Barbeque Villa, Panchavati Gaurav, Hotel Radhakrishna, Al-Khatib Dawat, etc.) with real photos from the media list.
Add interactive filters for cuisines, active search bar that filters displayed dishes/restaurants in real-time, and a dish preview dialog using Shadcn Dialog.
Add toast notification triggers (e.g. 'Link sent to your phone!', 'Restaurant added to favorites!') using Sonner.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and cards have proper data-testid attributes.
